title: Forgetting abelian groups gives an equivalence of left-exact functor categories
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a preadditive category with morphisms in $\mathrm{Type}(w)$ and finite biproducts. For a category $\mathcal B$, let $\mathcal A\mathbin{\to_\ell}\mathcal B$ denote the category of finite-limit-preserving functors from $\mathcal A$ to $\mathcal B$ and natural transformations. Postcomposition with the forgetful functor from abelian groups with carriers in $\mathrm{Type}(w)$ to $\mathrm{Type}(w)$ is the functor of an equivalence $(\mathcal A\mathbin{\to_\ell}\mathrm{AddCommGrp}(w))\simeq(\mathcal A\mathbin{\to_\ell}\mathrm{Type}(w))$. In particular it is fully faithful and therefore every natural isomorphism of the underlying set-valued functors of two left-exact abelian-group-valued functors has a unique lift to an additive natural isomorphism.

proof.text: Use AddCommGrpCat.leftExactFunctorForgetEquivalence. Its definition at lines 120-127 has functor postcomposition with forget AddCommGrpCat, so this is exactly the displayed equivalence. Full faithfulness of the functor of an equivalence gives the lifting clause (Functor.preimageIso and Functor.map_preimage).
